name: Hey Oliver
description_en:
Hey Oliver is centered on engaging people while they browse a website. Its Bubbly widget, inbound shout-out campaigns, visitor groups and tracking tools connect an onsite interaction to lead capture or an email response. That is a more specific starting point than treating it as a general CRM or an arbitrary imported-list email sequencer.

A practical evaluation asks whether the site can reliably identify the relevant page and action, show an appropriate message, and record what the visitor actually did. The public knowledge base provides concrete procedures, but many individual articles show old update ages. The findings here therefore describe documented behavior with current-plan caveats, not a verified live implementation or conversion result.
description_zh:
Hey Oliver 以访客浏览网站期间的互动为中心。Bubbly 组件、站内 shout-out 活动、访客分组与跟踪工具，将站内互动连接到线索获取或邮件回复。这比把它当作通用 CRM，或任意导入名单的邮件序列工具更符合其具体定位。

实际评估应检查网站能否可靠识别目标页面与动作、展示适当消息，并记录访客真正采取了什么行为。公开知识库提供具体程序，但许多独立文章显示较旧的更新时间。因此以下内容描述的是带有当前套餐范围限制的文档行为，未验证真实实施或转化结果。

core_features.explanation_en: Campaigns can appear instantly, on exit or after a chosen delay.
core_features.explanation_zh: 活动可立即、离站时或指定延迟后出现。

core_features.explanation_en: Group criteria can consider retained historical visitor data.
core_features.explanation_zh: 分组条件可考虑仍保留的历史访客数据。

core_features.name_zh: 与信息采集关联的回复
core_features.explanation_en: Autoresponders are linked to campaign types that ask for an email address.
core_features.explanation_zh: 自动回复与采集邮件地址的活动类型关联。

core_features.name_zh: 基于选择器的动作跟踪
core_features.explanation_en: Action tracking identifies an HTML element through an ID, class, name or attribute.
core_features.explanation_zh: 动作跟踪通过 ID、class、name 或属性识别 HTML 元素。

en: Editorial fit: a website operator testing page-specific lead capture and onsite assistance.
Editorial fit: a marketer who can coordinate visitor groups, tracking selectors and a limited number of concurrent campaigns.
zh: 编辑判断的适用场景：测试特定页面线索获取与站内帮助的网站运营人员。
编辑判断的适用场景：能够协调访客分组、跟踪选择器及有限并发活动的营销人员。
use_cases.basis: Editorial workflow examples; not observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Check domain and account code on a controlled website before building targeting rules.
steps.zh: 建立定位规则前，先在受控网站检查域名与账户代码。

steps.en: Create one internal enquiry campaign with an explicit target page and capture type.
steps.zh: 创建一条内部咨询活动，明确目标页面与信息采集类型。

steps.en: Verify action tracking and distinguish interaction labels from an actual conversion.
steps.zh: 验证动作跟踪，区分互动标签与真实转化。

steps.en: Check remaining-visitor replay, plan entitlement and current checkout terms before wider use.
steps.zh: 扩大使用前，检查剩余访客重播、套餐权限及当前结账条款。

items.en: Many knowledge-base articles show update ages of roughly 2,000–2,500 days; their current-version behavior was not exercised.
items.zh: 许多知识库文章显示约 2,000–2,500 天前更新，未操作验证其对当前版本的行为。

items.en: The detailed Form Tracking setup page returned a verification loader and was not bypassed.
items.zh: 详细 Form Tracking 设置页返回验证加载页，未绕过。

items.en: Visitor identity across browsers/devices, email retry and pause handling of queued replies remain unverified.
items.zh: 跨浏览器／设备身份、邮件重试及暂停时排队回复的处理仍未核实。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Observed monthly cards: Plus €69, Premium €99, Enterprise €199, for 10k/30k/90k new tracked visitors per month. Each lists one domain; concurrent campaigns are 3/5/10, users 1/5/10 and history retention 6/12/24 months. Current free availability is not established by older FAQ references. Autoresponders are excluded from Plus in the matrix. FAQ states cancellation is billed for the entire month and custom plans may add fees. No normalized checkout quote is assigned.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 实读月套餐卡：Plus 69 欧元、Premium 99 欧元、Enterprise 199 欧元，对应每月 1 万／3 万／9 万新跟踪访客。每档列一个域名；并发活动为 3／5／10，用户数为 1／5／10，历史保留为六／12／24 个月。旧 FAQ 的 Free 引用不足以确认当前免费可用性。矩阵显示 Plus 不含自动回复。FAQ 说明取消仍收整月费用，定制套餐可能另计费。不生成标准化结账报价。

sources.title: Plans & Pricing - Marketing Automation Software - Hey Oliver
sources.research_notes_en: Read three monthly cards, tracked-new-visitor and concurrency dimensions, one domain and actual checkmark feature table. Free references in FAQ do not establish a current ongoing free entitlement.

sources.title: FAQ - Questions on our Marketing Automation Tool - Hey Oliver
sources.research_notes_en: Read monthly cancellation billing, custom-plan extra-fee caveat, installation and Free/four-plan references inconsistent with three current cards. No ROI percentages adopted.

sources.title: How do I install Hey Oliver on my website? - Hey Oliver Knowledge Base
sources.research_notes_en: Read account tracking code placement on each intended page before closing body. Article has an old relative update age; not a current-version execution test.

sources.title: Bubbly isn't showing up on my site even though I've installed the code. What am I missing? - Hey Oliver Knowledge Base
sources.research_notes_en: Read domain registration, exact account code and browser inspection checks. No live site modified.

sources.title: How can I create a shout-out campaign? - Hey Oliver Knowledge Base
sources.research_notes_en: Read actual shout-out creation, URL fragment plus Enter, lead-capture types and instant/exit/seconds triggers. Relative update age is old.

sources.title: Can I stop or pause a marketing campaign? - Hey Oliver Knowledge Base
sources.research_notes_en: Read Stop/Play only for remaining visitors who have not seen campaign; delete is irreversible. No inference about queued autoresponder recall.

sources.title: What do Positive, Ignored and Negative mean? - Hey Oliver Knowledge Base
sources.research_notes_en: Read Positive as click or contact submission, Ignored as seen without action, Negative as closing shout-out. Not purchase/conversion causation.

sources.title: How do I set-up conversions? - Hey Oliver Knowledge Base
sources.research_notes_en: Read Form Tracking and Action Tracking prerequisites before creating conversion; actual form tracking procedure returned a verification loader and was not bypassed.

sources.title: Will Hey Oliver take into consideration all the users I’ve had up to now if I decide to create a new group today? - Hey Oliver Knowledge Base
sources.research_notes_en: Read historical group inclusion. Its all-history example must be bounded by current plan browsing-history retention; no guarantee of indefinite retained data.

sources.title: What is the use of email autoresponders on Hey Oliver? - Hey Oliver Knowledge Base
sources.research_notes_en: Read autoresponder restricted to campaign-creator email-capture types; unrelated to arbitrary imported-list sequencing.

sources.title: How do I set up Action Tracking? - Hey Oliver Knowledge Base
sources.research_notes_en: Read action tracking using HTML identifier/value and unique selector requirements; website changes can invalidate selectors. No tracking code executed.

official_check.scope: Official public documentation only; no purchase, account operation, sending test, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.
Existing third-party source is discovery-only and superseded. Unknown UI languages, regional availability and licensing remain unknown.
All publication and alternative-relationship states remain unapproved.

sections.title_en: Confirm the widget before evaluating a campaign
sections.title_zh: 评估活动前先确认组件运行
sections.en: The installation article retrieves the site’s tracking code from Settings > Account and places it before the closing body tag on each page to track. The missing-widget article then checks the configured domain, exact account code and a browser inspection message. These checks establish a diagnostic sequence, not proof of complete tracking. In an evaluation, inspect both a target page and a page that should not show the campaign, using the actual site setup and approved internal traffic.
sections.zh: 安装文章要求从 Settings > Account 取得网站跟踪代码，放在每个需要跟踪页面的 body 结束标签前。组件缺失文章随后检查已配置域名、账户对应的准确代码，以及浏览器检查信息。这些步骤构成排障顺序，并不证明跟踪完整。评估时应使用真实网站配置和批准的内部流量，同时检查目标页面与不应显示活动的页面。

sections.title_en: A page-specific offer needs explicit targeting
sections.title_zh: 特定页面优惠需要明确定位
sections.en: For a hypothetical service enquiry campaign, choose an objective, audience and email-capture shout-out, then restrict it to the relevant service page. The creator article says to enter the URL portion after the domain and press Enter to validate each entry. Trigger choices include instant, exit and a delay in seconds. Preview before running, and test the non-target page too. A field that requests an address is not evidence that the visitor agreed to unrelated future marketing.
sections.zh: 假设创建服务咨询活动，可先选择目标、受众及采集邮箱的 shout-out，再将其限定到相关服务页。创建器文章要求输入域名之后的 URL 部分，并按 Enter 使每项生效。触发方式包括立即、离站和按秒延迟。运行前应预览，并测试非目标页。表单要求填写地址，不代表访客已同意不相关的后续营销。

sections.title_en: A new group and replayed campaign use different histories
sections.title_zh: 新分组与重播活动使用不同历史
sections.en: The group article says new groups consider historical data. Interpret that against the current plan’s retained browsing-history window rather than its older unlimited-history example. Separately, Stop can be followed by Play, but the documented replay targets the remaining visitors who have not seen the campaign. It is not a documented reset of every prior impression. Deleting a campaign is described as irreversible. Check repeat-visitor behavior before using replay as a recovery step.
sections.zh: 分组文章说新分组会考虑历史数据，应以当前套餐的浏览历史保留窗口限定理解，不能沿用旧例子推断无限保留。另外，Stop 后可以 Play，但文档所述重播面向尚未看过活动的剩余访客，并非重置此前全部曝光。删除活动被描述为不可逆。将重播用作恢复步骤前，应检查重复访客的实际行为。

sections.title_en: Autoresponders start from an email-capture campaign
sections.title_zh: 自动回复从采集邮箱活动开始
sections.en: The autoresponder article restricts the feature to campaign-creator campaigns of the Ask for email or Ask for email/phone type. It does not establish an arbitrary multi-step email sequence for every imported contact. For an evaluation, inspect the collected address, response template and actual message in an internal mailbox. The public pricing matrix also distinguishes Plus from higher plans for autoresponders; a general marketing-automation label should not be read as every email capability being included.
sections.zh: 自动回复文章将该功能限定于 Campaign Creator 中 Ask for email 或 Ask for email/phone 类型活动。它没有确认可对每个导入联系人建立任意多步邮件序列。评估时应检查采集地址、回复模板及内部邮箱实际收到的消息。公开定价矩阵也对 Plus 与更高套餐的自动回复权限作了区分，不能因营销自动化总标签就认为包含全部邮件能力。

sections.title_en: Positive is an interaction label, not a purchase
sections.title_zh: Positive 是互动标签，不等于购买
sections.en: For shout-outs, Positive means a clicked link or submitted contact details; Ignored means seen without action, and Negative means the visitor closed the message. Conversion setup is separate and requires Form Tracking and Action Tracking first. The action guide relies on the intended HTML element’s identifier and value, so a selector change can undermine the measurement. Test a known click and an unrelated element after a site redesign. The form-setup article returned a verification loader, so its detailed configuration was not verified.
sections.zh: 对 shout-out 而言，Positive 表示点击链接或提交联系方式，Ignored 表示看过但未行动，Negative 表示访客关闭消息。转化设置是独立步骤，前提为已配置 Form Tracking 和 Action Tracking。动作指南依赖目标 HTML 元素的标识与值，因此选择器变化可能损害测量。网站改版后应测试一次已知点击及一个不相关元素。表单设置文章返回验证加载页，因此详细配置未核实。

sections.title_en: Budget around new visitors and simultaneous campaigns
sections.title_zh: 按新访客与并发活动估算
sections.en: The three public cards charge by plan and list new tracked visitors, concurrent campaigns, team size and history retention, with one domain on each. The FAQ still refers to four plans and a Free account, whereas the current cards show three paid plans. It also describes full-month billing after cancellation and possible extra fees for custom arrangements. These differences leave current free availability, checkout eligibility and custom scope unresolved. The Get it links go to an external offer; no purchase flow was completed.
sections.zh: 三个公开套餐卡按套餐收费，列出新跟踪访客、并发活动、团队人数及历史保留期，每档都列一个域名。FAQ 仍提到四个套餐和 Free 账户，当前卡片却显示三个付费套餐。它还说明取消后仍按整月收费，定制安排可能另有费用。因此当前免费可用性、结账资格及定制范围仍未解决。Get it 链接跳往外部优惠，本次未完成购买流程。

seo.title_en: Hey Oliver: website campaigns, visitor groups and autoresponder limits
seo.title_zh: Hey Oliver：网站活动、访客分组与自动回复边界
seo.description_en: Evaluate Hey Oliver installation, page targeting, replay behavior, interaction metrics and visitor-based pricing from official pages.
seo.description_zh: 依据官方页面评估 Hey Oliver 安装、页面定位、重播行为、互动指标及访客计费。
seo.primary_intent: Understand Hey Oliver onsite visitor marketing and campaign limits
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent; no search volume, ranking or AI visibility measured.

research_gaps.en: No code installation, site campaign, form submission, email send or purchase was performed.
research_gaps.zh: 未安装代码、运行网站活动、提交表单、发送邮件或购买。

research_gaps.en: Exact current offer, free-plan availability, taxes, overage handling and account eligibility remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 具体当前优惠、免费套餐可用性、税费、超额处理及账户资格仍未核实。

research_gaps.en: Form Tracking detail, interface languages, self-hosting rights and current-version validity of old help articles remain unresolved.
research_gaps.zh: Form Tracking 细节、界面语言、自托管权利及旧帮助文章对当前版本的有效性仍未解决。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation. Examples and fit judgments are editorial, not executed tests.
